plugin.note: Smoke devil strategy: use Ice Barrage or Ice Burst with a dwarf multicannon, Protect from Missiles, and a facemask or Slayer helmet. Kodai wand is best because it autocasts Ancient Magicks, gives magic damage, supplies water runes, and can save runes.

requirements: Facemask or Slayer helmet for smoke protection
94 Magic for Ice Barrage; Ice Burst can be used at lower Magic
Dwarf multicannon and cannonballs for efficient grouping
High Defence and magic-damage armour such as Virtus or Ancestral are recommended
82+ Construction for ornate pool and jewellery box is recommended, or use ring of dueling for Ferox Enclave and Castle Wars
mechanics: Smoke devils attack only with ranged, and Protect from Missiles prevents all damage from their attacks.
The dungeon is smoky; players not wearing a facemask or Slayer helmet take periodic 10 damage.
Without face protection, Smoke devil attacks deal very rapid damage and drain stats.
Misclicking a Slayer helmet off the head, or equipping a rune full helm drop by mistake, can quickly lead to death.
Smoke devils have high defence and some magic defence, but their Magic level is low enough that barrage spells remain accurate.
The Smoke Devil Dungeon is large, so the cannon is used primarily to pull and stack monsters for barrage hits.
Valuable common drops such as rune chainbody, fire battlestaves, and air battlestaves help offset rune and cannonball costs; occult necklace drops can make the task profitable.
Bracelet of slaughter is usually favoured over Tormented bracelet because longer tasks maximise Slayer experience.

methods.label: Requirements and transportation
methods.summary: Bank, restore, and enter the Smoke Devil Dungeon with smoke protection and cannon supplies.
recommendedFor: Players using Castle Wars or fairy ring access
steps: Bank at Castle Wars and run south-west to the Smoke Devil Dungeon entrance.
Alternatively use fairy ring BKP, then run south-west of the dungeon.
Use Ferox Enclave through ring of dueling or a player-owned house ornate pool to restore stats between trips.
Enter with a facemask or Slayer helmet equipped before taking Smoke devil attacks.
Run to the centre of the main room to place the cannon.
risks: Smoke devils can only be fought on task.
Removing the Slayer helmet in combat can cause rapid stat-draining damage.

methods.label: Smoke protection
methods.summary: Use face protection and Protect from Missiles to remove incoming Smoke devil damage.
recommendedFor: Players picking up rune full helm drops
steps: Keep Protect from Missiles active; Smoke devils attack only with ranged.
Wear a facemask or Slayer helmet to prevent dungeon smoke and stat-draining attack damage.
Avoid unequipping the Slayer helmet when checking task count.
Do not misclick rune full helm drops into the head slot.
Restore stats at Ferox Enclave or a player-owned house if smoke damage or mistakes drain stats.
risks: Face protection mistakes can become lethal quickly when multiple Smoke devils are attacking.
Prayer dropping exposes the player to all grouped ranged attacks.

methods.label: Cannon barrage grouping
methods.summary: Use the cannon to aggro the room, then stack Smoke devils around the western skeletons for barrage hits.
recommendedFor: Imbued heart and eternal gem hunting through superior spawns
steps: Place the cannon in the centre of the room to get Smoke devils attacking.
Run around each side of the skeleton to the west to group up Smoke devils from each direction.
Cast Ice Barrage into the stack to maximise multi-target hits.
Use Ice Burst at lower Magic if Ice Barrage is unavailable.
Reload the cannon if the account does not have enough Combat Achievements cannonball capacity for one full lure rotation.
Restore the stack when three or less Smoke devils are left.
Use a ranged weapon lure only when cannon use is impractical; the strategy page notes this is slower and mainly useful for some ironman accounts, especially ultimate ironmen.
risks: Trying to stack the large cave without a cannon is significantly slower.
Poor grouping lowers barrage hits and experience rates.
Cannonball and rune costs are high, though common drops often compensate.

methods.label: Magic equipment
methods.summary: Prioritise Ancient Magicks autocast, magic damage, and enough accuracy for Smoke devils' magic defence.
recommendedFor: Players choosing between damage bracelet and Slayer experience
steps: Use Kodai wand where available because it can autocast Ancient Magicks, gives +15% magic damage, provides infinite water runes, and has a chance to save runes.
Use Volatile nightmare staff, Nightmare staff, Dragon hunter wand, Ancient sceptre, Blue moon spear, or Accursed sceptre as downgrade paths.
Use Slayer helmet (i) on task, or a facemask only when not using the helmet.
Use Virtus, Ancestral, Ahrim's, Dagon'hai, or Infinity robes based on budget.
Prefer Bracelet of slaughter for longer tasks and better overall Slayer experience; Tormented bracelet increases max hit but shortens the task.
Use Elidinis' ward, Arcane spirit shield, Ancient wyvern shield, Mage's book, Malediction ward, or Book of darkness as off-hand options.

methods.label: Inventory and loot
methods.summary: Bring cannon parts, runes, bracelets, and restoration while banking/alching enough drops to offset costs.
recommendedFor: Players sustaining rune and cannonball costs
requiredOrKeyItems: Volatile nightmare staff or special attack weapon
inventory: Saturated heart or other Magic boost
Rune pouch with water, blood, and death runes
Teleport to house or ring of dueling
steps: Bring all four cannon pieces and enough cannonballs for the expected lure rotations.
Use water, blood, and death runes for Ice Barrage; Kodai wand supplies water runes.
Use Bracelet of slaughter to lengthen tasks and maximise Slayer experience.
Keep valuable common drops such as rune chainbody, fire battlestaves, and air battlestaves when inventory allows.
Prioritise occult necklace drops and superior spawns as the major profit spikes.
Use Explorer's ring or rune pouch alchemy only if it does not interrupt the barrage stack.
notes: The strategy page says realistic experience is about 120,000 Slayer experience per hour, with up to 180,000 per hour possible depending on efficiency.

styleOptions.label: Ice Barrage cannon
styleOptions.summary: Kodai wand or other Ancient Magicks autocast staff with cannon grouping.

styleOptions.label: Ice Burst budget
styleOptions.summary: Lower-Magic version of the same cannon grouping method using Ice Burst.

styleOptions.label: Ranged lure ironman
styleOptions.summary: Manual ranged lure with a weapon such as Magic shortbow; slower and mainly useful for some ironman accounts.

body:
# Smoke devil

Use Ice Barrage or Ice Burst with a dwarf multicannon in the Smoke Devil Dungeon. Wear a facemask or Slayer helmet, keep Protect from Missiles active, and group Smoke devils around the western skeletons for multi-target barrage hits.
